story.iWant: to log in to my account securely using my email and password
story.soThat: I can access my personalized dashboard and study plans.
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create the Login UI form using Shadcn UI components (Input, Button, Label). (AC: 1) - Task 2: Implement the `signIn` method in the `AuthManager` service to call `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword()`. (AC: 2) - Task 3: Connect the form's "Log In" button to the `AuthManager.signIn` method and handle the loading state. (AC: 2) - Task 4: Upon successful login, update the global `zustand` store with the user's session object. (AC: 3) - Task 5: Implement client-side routing to redirect the user to the dashboard page after a successful login. (AC: 4) - Task 6: Implement UI error handling on the form to display specific messages for "Invalid login credentials" and "Please verify your email". (AC: 5, 6) - Task 7: Write a unit test for the `AuthManager.signIn` method, mocking the Supabase client and testing success and failure cases. - Task 8: Write a component test for the Login form, verifying its behavior in different states (initial, loading, error).

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - AC 1: Given I am on the application's login page, Then the UI must display a form with fields for "Email" and "Password," and a "Log In" button. - AC 2: Given I have entered my correct credentials for a verified account, When I click the "Log In" button, Then the client-side `AuthManager.signIn(credentials)` function must be invoked. - AC 3: Given the `signIn` call to Supabase is successful, Then the application must receive a valid JWT session, which is stored securely in the client. - AC 4: Given I have successfully logged in, When the application navigates, Then I must be redirected to my personal dashboard page. - AC 5: Given I attempt to log in with incorrect credentials, Then the login must fail, and a clear error message (e.g., "Invalid login credentials") must be displayed on the login form. - AC 6: Given I attempt to log in with a correct password but an unverified email address, Then the login must fail, and a message must be displayed informing me that my email needs to be verified, as per `story-1-002` and `story-1-003`.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: The `AuthManager` module will expose a `signIn(credentials: { email, password }): Promise<{ session, error }>;` method.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: User Login: User submits the login form. `AuthManager` calls `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password })`. Supabase verifies credentials and returns a JWT session. `AuthManager` stores the session and redirects the user to the dashboard.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: For form validation errors, specific error messages will appear inline, directly beneath the relevant input field, providing immediate and contextual guidance.

story-context.constraints: - Must use the `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword()` method via the `AuthManager` service. - On successful login, the user session must be stored in the `zustand` global state. - On successful login, the user must be redirected to the dashboard. - The UI must show distinct error messages for invalid credentials versus an unverified email. - All UI must be built with Shadcn UI components.

interface.name: IAuthManager.signIn
interface.signature: signIn(credentials: { email, password }): Promise<{ session, error }>;

tests.standards: Use Cypress or Playwright for E2E tests, and Jest/RTL for unit and component tests.
tests.locations: - Unit/Service Tests: `src/services/__tests__/` - Component Tests: `src/components/__tests__/` - E2E Tests: `cypress/e2e/`
tests.ideas: - (AC 2, 3, 4) E2E test for a successful login flow, including the redirect to the dashboard. - (AC 5) E2E test for a failed login attempt with incorrect credentials, verifying the error message. - (AC 6) E2E test for a failed login attempt with an unverified email, verifying the specific error message and the presence of a "Resend verification" link/button. - Unit test the `AuthManager.signIn` method, mocking both successful and failed responses from Supabase.
